title: Analyze This
about: A mob boss having panic attacks secretly books in with a nervous psychiatrist.
cue: Serve dessert when Paul first turns up at Ben's office.
faces: A private dinner of the families
Our host, in session. He is fine. He is totally fine.
Gin, red bitter, sweet vermouth, orange.
Jelly is at the bar. Don’t ask him anything.
Menu arranged by the consigliere. No guns at the table, please.
Eat. Talk. How does it make you feel?
As at the Miami wedding. Interrupted.
Comfort food. I can't work miracles.
Tomato slow-cooked with pork, basil, pecorino.
Crumbed cutlet, marinara, mozzarella, parmesan, spaghetti.
Like his mother made. We won’t go there.
Sweet ricotta, orange zest, chocolate-dipped ends.
